q: Foꝛ they gyue lyght and teche the people ſymple and ygnoꝛaunt/and vnto them gyue good ſauour and deuocyon in pꝛeſeruynge them vnto theyr power from the ſtenche ⁊ coꝛrupcyon of all ſynne by good example of lyfe/by good doctryne ⁊ good exoꝛtacyon/and in ſoo doynge the holy fader of mercy vnto them pꝛomyſeth to make theym grete in the realme of paradyſe.

1506 [1490], Andrew Chertsey (possibly), transl., Thordynary of Crysten Men [The Ordinary of Christian Men], London: Wynkyn de Worde, translation of L'Ordinaire des Chrestiens, →OCLC, unnumbered page:
